mapper.select:
SELECT dr.defense_id as defenseRecordId, u.name AS userName, u.user_number as userNumber, u.profile_picture AS profilePicture, dt.topic_name AS topicName, dr.score AS score, dr.defense_date AS defenseTime FROM defense_records dr JOIN users u ON dr.user_id = u.user_id JOIN defense_topics dt ON dr.topic_id = dt.topic_id
and u.name like concat('%',#{userName},'%') and u.user_number like concat('%',#{userNumber},'%') and dt.topic_name like concat('%',#{topicName},'%')
ORDER BY dr.defense_date DESC

select dr.defense_id as defenseId, users.name as studentName, users.user_number as studentNumber, dr.defense_date as defenseTime, dr.video_url as defenseVideoUrl, dr.report_url as defenseReportUrl, dr.video_analysis as aiVideoAnalysis, dr.report_analysis as aiReportAnalysis, dr.feedback as aiAllAnalysis from defense_records dr join users on dr.user_id = users.user_id where dr.defense_id = #{defenseId}

select da.answer_id as answerId, dq.question, dq.question_type as questionType, da.student_answer as studentAnswer, da.score, da.feedback, da.created_at as createdAt from defense_answers as da join defense_questions as dq on da.question_id = dq.question_id where da.defense_id = #{defenseId}

select dr.defense_id as defenseRecordId, u.Name as userName, u.user_number as userNumber, u.profile_picture as profilePicture, dt.topic_name as topicName, dr.score, dr.created_at as defenseTime from defense_records dr left join users u on u.user_id = dr.user_id left join defense_topics dt on dt.topic_id = dr.topic_id where u.user_number = #{userNumber}

select topic_id as topicId, teacher_id as teacherId, topic_name as topicName, topic_description as topicDescription, defense_time as defenseTime, created_at as createdAt from defense_topics order by defense_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO defense_records (user_id, video_url, created_at) SELECT u.user_id, #{url}, NOW() FROM users u WHERE u.user_number = #{userId} LIMIT 1
